duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only joint sustained-wind/gust ratio distribution, excess magnitude and excess persistence over full and recent context
duplication_audit.distinction: v20 uses one current gust-excess scalar inside a KMA adjustment and the older analog audit uses one context mean excess; v26 applies generic fixed convolutions to the raw gust channel. v80 instead seals an explicitly physical gust-factor ratio and gust-excess intermittency distribution over two historical windows. It is not reconstructible from their stored outputs and uses no KMA/prior predictions.
duplication_audit.full_registry_boundary: Distinct from v29-v79 recurrence, embedding, spectral, decomposition, tail, volatility, crossing, record, ordinal, topology, causality, covariance, mode, and intrinsic-time representations; no prior output is consumed.
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 per-case gust-factor distribution plus excess-persistence residual contract was found.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: v64, v78/v79 and all prior/official results are excluded from features, gates, fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: past-only sustained wind speed and gust on the native context, linearly filled within the observed prefix and sampled on the fixed 20-minute grid

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Wieringa, Gust factors over open water and built-up country, Boundary-Layer Meteorology 3, 424-441 (1973)
primary_sources.use: open-water gust-factor mechanism motivation only; no P3 performance claim
